en.headline: Ride-hailing licence applications close as platforms file with Transport Department
en.dek: The noon deadline passed on Friday with companies including DiDi, Gaode and Uber submitting for service licences under the new regime.
body: The Transport Department said applications for ride-hailing service licences closed at noon on Friday.

Several platforms submitted documents on the final morning. DiDi said it would cooperate with the approval process and continue preparations, adding that it supported coexistence with taxis after registering more taxi drivers in recent months. Gaode expressed confidence in its integrated travel platform and said it would fully comply with the rules to offer safer choices. Uber had earlier confirmed it had lodged its application. TADA was also among those filing, according to reports.

Licences may run for up to five years with an annual fee of HK$1.2 million. The first batch of platform licences is expected from late November, subject to assessment of operational experience, financial capacity and service standards. Vehicle permits are capped at 10,000 in the initial phase, with further invitations for vehicle and driver permits planned for the fourth quarter.

zh.headline: 網約車服務牌照申請中午截止 多間平台向運輸署遞交文件
zh.dek: 周五中午申請期結束，滴滴、高德及Uber等公司已提交網約車服務牌照申請，新規管制度下首批牌照料十一月底起批出。
body: 運輸署表示，網約車服務牌照申請已於周五中午十二時截止。
多間平台在最後一早上遞交文件。滴滴表示會積極配合審批程序，持續推進準備工作，並指支持的士與網約車共存互補，近月新登記的士司機有所增加。高德香港公共事務主管楊旭波表示，公司以提供優質出行服務為出發點，認同以民為本及安全規管原則，對一體化出行平台充滿信心。Uber早前已確認正式遞交申請。據報，TADA亦有代表前往遞交。
牌照有效期最長五年，每年牌費一百二十萬元。首批平台牌照預計十一月底起陸續批出，須經評估營運經驗、財務能力及服務水平。現階段網約車車輛許可證上限為一萬個，車輛及駕駛許可證申請料於第四季展開。
